verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs explicitly claim fine-grained reactivity via Angular Signals for reactive/fast state updates, directly matching the story of dependent UI re-running on state change (angular-docs-1). However, evidence lacks deeper technical detail (e.g., benchmarks, hands-on developer confirmation of signals' fine-grained re-rendering) and no independent corroboration exists—community comments predate Signals entirely and focus on older change-detection performance issues. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Signals' fine-grained reactivity, detailed docs on computed/effect dependency tracking, benchmarks comparing to full re-render.
